verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Cactus models run on-device with "no server, and no data leaving the device" on phones, Pis and desktops (macOS, Linux and Windows, no GPU), installed via `brew install` plus `cactus run`. Hands-on users confirm offline use on an Android phone and on a Framework Desktop. missing for 10: documentation that the optional automatic cloud routing of hard queries can be disabled or is off by default, independent verification that no prompt data leaves the device.
